title: evaluator/frameworks.json
description: The installed frameworks a command evaluator depends on (Stories 1.44, 1.71 and 1.73, AD-21): per framework its package, one exact version and a tracked probe under evaluator/. An optional installState source is tree or lockfile; the probe must then report an observed installDigest beside package and version. A probe may set probeTimeoutMs from 1 to 60000; an omitted value defaults to 10000 and evaluator.timeoutMs caps it. An evaluator with no installed framework dependency declares an empty list. The tea-evaluate runtime owns this schema.

version.description: One exact version starting with a digit: no tag, range, wildcard segment, space or backtick.
